cases.question: How many days of bereavement leave do employees receive for the death of a sibling?
expected_facts: 5 days of paid leave on the death of an immediate family member (spouse, partner, child, parent, sibling)
evidence_quotes: Employees receive 5 days of paid leave on the death of an immediate family member (spouse, partner, child, parent, sibling) and 2 days for an extended family member.
cases.reference_answer: Employees receive 5 days of paid leave on the death of an immediate family member (spouse, partner, child, parent, sibling).

cases.question: What are the conditions for employees to work remotely and when must timesheets be submitted?
evidence_quotes: After completing probation, employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with their line manager's agreement.
cases.reference_answer: Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with their line manager's agreement, and remote working days must be recorded in the HR portal by the end of the previous week. Timesheets must be submitted by the 25th of each month.

cases.question: How long is a final written warning considered valid for in the company's disciplinary process?
evidence_quotes: A written warning remains valid for 12 months and a final written warning for 18 months.
cases.reference_answer: A final written warning remains valid for 18 months.

cases.question: What are the maximum limits for hotel expenses and daily meals according to company policies?
evidence_quotes: The maximum hotel rate is 140 USD per night.
cases.reference_answer: The maximum hotel rate is 140 USD per night and the daily meal allowance is 45 USD.

cases.question: When is the last day to use carry-over leave?
evidence_quotes: Carried-over days must be used by 31 March, after which they lapse without payment.
cases.reference_answer: Carried-over days must be used by 31 March, after which they lapse without payment.

cases.question: How many days does an employee have to take compensatory time off after working overtime without any extensions?
evidence_quotes: Compensatory time off must be taken within 60 days of the overtime being worked.
cases.reference_answer: Compensatory time off must be taken within 60 days of the overtime being worked.

cases.question: What are the eligibility criteria for remote work and when do timesheets need to be submitted?

cases.reference_answer: Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week if their line manager agrees, and timesheets must be submitted by the 25th of each month.

cases.question: What is the standard working week for shore staff and when are the core hours set?

cases.reference_answer: The standard working week for shore staff is 40 hours from Monday to Friday, with core hours set from 10:00 to 15:00.
